parts.say: [excited] 13 years. 13 years of waiting… and today, GTA 6 is FINALLY out.
And the hype right now? Absolutely insane.
On Twitch, over 3 million people were watching at the same time. Never seen before.
Twitch, YouTube, Kick: over 6 million live viewers at launch.
And the views? The first trailer: 90 million views in 24 hours. A world record.
In total, the trailers have passed half a billion views, on YouTube alone.
But the craziest part is in real life. Thousands of people took the day off.
Logitech gave its 7,000 employees a day off. Conor McGregor did the same for his 400 staff.
In the US, almost one worker in five planned to skip work today. People are already calling it… the GTA flu.
So… did YOU take the day off? Tell me in the comments, and follow for more GTA 6.
